web.description: He made his senior international debut for Norway in 2019, and has since scored 62 goals in 54 appearances, making him Norway's all-time top goalscorer. snippets: He made his senior international debut for Norway in 2019, and has since scored 62 goals in 54 appearances, making him Norway's all-time top goalscorer. Haaland is the sixth player to reach 50 international goals in under 50 appearances, doing so in 46 games. At the 2026 FIFA World Cup, Haaland helped Norway reach the quarter-finals—the nation's best-ever World Cup finish—scoring seven goals. Erling Braut Haaland was born on 21 July 2000 in Leeds, West Yorkshire, England, while his father Alfie Haaland was playing football for Leeds United.

Haaland started playing at the academy of his hometown club Bryne at the age of five. Five of the players from this youth team went on play on Norway youth national teams. During the 2015 and 2016 seasons, he played for Bryne 2 (Bryne's reserve team) in the Norwegian fourth tier, scoring 18 goals in 18 matches. The following season he scored his first career hat-trick at the age of 16.

He made his debut for the club on 26 April in a Norwegian Cup match against Volda TI, scoring once in a 3–2 win. Haaland's debut in the Eliteserien came on 4 June. He came on as a substitute in the 71st minute against Sarpsborg 08, and he received a yellow card within two minutes. On 6 August, Haaland scored the winning goal against Tromsø IL, his first goal in the league.

On 1 July 2018, Haaland scored four goals in the opening 21 minutes against Brann, securing his team a 4–0 victory over the unbeaten league leaders at the time. After the match, Molde manager Ole Gunnar Solskjær compared Haaland's style of play to Belgian forward Romelu Lukaku, and said the club had rejected several bids for the striker from different clubs.

The Athletic's Phil Hay would later reveal that prior to his move to Salzburg, Haaland was also subject of an offer from his father's former club Leeds United. He made his debut for the club on 17 February, the 2018–19 Austrian Cup quarter-finals against Wiener Neustadt, and scored his first goal on 12 May in the Austrian Bundesliga 2–1 win over LASK.

snippets: Haaland scored his first FA Cup goals with a hat-trick against Burnley. It was his second hat-trick in the space of a week and sixth of his 2022/23 season. The striker was rested for the club's first FA Cup match against Chelsea (Third Round), and their Round of 16 match at Bristol City.

This gave him another slice of history, with Haaland the first City player ever to score five goals in two separate matches after he amassed the same haul against RB Leipzig in the Champions League in 2023. He became the first City player since Frank Roberts in 1926 to score five goals in an FA Cup match, while also becoming the first man in the club's history to reach seven FA Cup goals as quickly as his fifth appearance in the competition.

Haaland has scored a combined 354 goals for club and country at senior level as of November 9, 2025 (299 for club, and 55 for Norway). His most prolific international year has been 2025: a remarkable five goals in an 11-1 win over Moldova helped him to reach 13 goals scored in just seven games.

Erling Haaland has broken records and lifted trophies since joining Manchester City and a monster new contract means he is set to spend most of the next decade at the Etihad Stadium. ... The Norway striker has an uncanny ability to find the back of the net and has done so everywhere he's gone. He helped City win the UEFA Champions League for the first time to cap off an incredible individual season by adding to his Premier League and FA Cup medal in 2022/23.

Just two short of a double century of matches for the Blues, Haaland has been almost a permanent fixture in our starting XI since making his debut away to West Ham United in 2022. Of those games, 132 have come in the Premier League where he has so far scored 112 goals at an average of 98 minutes per goal.

An overlooked part of Haaland’s game is making goals for team-mates. His 29 to date mean that he averages just over seven assists per campaign – a more than decent return and evidence if needed of his mentality of being a team player, as well as am effective defender at set-pieces. Like any striker worth their salt, Erling isn’t shy at taking shots.

Including Bryne FK, Molde, Red Bull Salzburg and Borussia Dortmund, Haaland has already surpassed the 400 games threshold. It’s 11 seasons since he made his debut for Bryne FK as a 14-year-old and he has packed more into that time than most players manage in an entire career. And at just 25-years-old, our No.9 has plenty of gas left in the tank . An incredible number of goals only elite strikers reach, Erling’s goal-scoring is already the stuff of legend.

He averages 0.78 goals per game so far, which is a phenomenal return. ... No wonder Erling Haaland is adored by Norwegians. His return of 55 goals in 50 games has helped Norway become one of the most improved European nations in the past couple of years and now he is set to shine at the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
